member: a Westinghouse-type PWR at the start of its fuel cycle (1690 ppm), load-following with rods and boron

alpha_coolant.why: start-of-cycle MTC, near zero at high boron; 0 itself is the bound of the range, kept out as degenerate

boron_worth.why: BEAVRS hot zero power 10.8 to 10.9 pcm/ppm; NRC search summaries 6.7 and 8.2 at power

restart_steps.why: a scram's restart, 24 to 70 h (Doel-3; APR1400)

floor_allowed.why: time to restore Tavg above its floor, 15 to 30 min

coupled_why: both follow the core's boron (ours, from the physics): more boron makes the MTC less negative and each ppm worth less, so the MTC's most negative end (-20) goes with the largest worth (-10.9), as BEAVRS measures 10.8 at lower boron
